version.changelog:
- Added support for retrieving Tiger Sniff (虎嗅网) 24-hour module news aggregation and details.
- Updated description and usage instructions to reflect new 24小时模块 scenarios.
- Adjusted output format to generalize for both articles and fast news ("内容摘要" instead of fixed text length).
- Clarified that multiple hot topics are displayed as lists, and noted typical "持续更新" tags on headline news.

llm.summary: This skill only tells the agent how to fetch and summarize Huxiu.com news and article pages.

dimensions.detail: Network fetching from huxiu.com is proportionate to the news-reading purpose; no local files, credentials, shell commands, or private data access are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected package contains only a Markdown SKILL.md artifact and no executable install scripts or dependencies.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The runtime instructions are clear and scoped to web_fetch of disclosed Huxiu article or moment URLs with bounded maxChars values.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background execution, memory writes, tool wrapping, or system modification behavior is present.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to retrieve Huxiu homepage, 24-hour feed, and article content; the instructions are limited to fetching Huxiu URLs and summarizing titles, authors, times, and content.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Installers should understand that the skill directs the agent to access Huxiu web pages and summarize public news content. Keep use to the disclosed Huxiu URL patterns, especially when providing article links.
